dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: I'm quite comfortable. Don't worry, I'm not one of those crabby old geezers who love to find fault with everything... I'm usually quite easy to please...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Maybe I do nitpick every once in a while... but only with disrespectful students. Or those nonsensical rules at the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: You're very agreeable, and the scenery here is quite lovely, so why wouldn't I like it here?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Haha, one does not run into youngsters as kind and considerate as yourself nowadays.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Let's say, hypothetically, I were to discover some design flaws after staying here for some time... you wouldn't mind if I shared them with you, would you?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Good, good. It seems like I'll be able to research my interests here to my heart's content after all.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Even if it ends up taking me another hundred years... Hehe, I will be quite content here.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Hmm... Could you get me some pens and paper?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: When I arrived in this realm for the first time, I was very surprised indeed by the unique configuration.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Just what kind of mechanism allows all of this to be ensconced in a single teapot... I need to do some research...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: But it wouldn't be polite to leave you with piles of notes everywhere...
